g.text: Which AI model reads your mail?
recipe uses an AI model to:
• AI tries the junk rules on a sample, you check it
• AI reads each email: a summary, and keep or junk
Your mail is sent to the AI server at
localhost means your own machine; anything else, make sure you
trust it. To use another server (Ollama, for example), quit and
Type the model's name exactly as that server lists it, and keep it
LM Studio: the name is under My Models, or run `lms ls`.
